note: Customer-facing category menu. kb_categories maps each menu item to kb_rules.category values used to scope the AI prompt. GENERAL RULES is always included as shared context. Labels are English master; translate via locales files. v1.1 (spec v1.5): added the per-plan manual (Pxxx); 'PLAN FILE: General Rules …' shared for payment/cancel/replace/reissue/refund/return; per-plan sheets only via Others('*') until a plan-selection step (backlog). v1.2 (spec v1.6): added the CS-feedback manual ('CS FEEDBACK: …', Fxxx) to each matching topic. v1.3 (spec v1.6 Phase 5): removed the Nenkin/Gensen tile per CS — its 'PLAN FILE: Nenkin …' rules remain in the DB, reachable only via Others('*'). v1.4 (spec v1.7 CS docs): added the CS AI docs manual ('CS AI DOC: …', Cxxx, section-granularity) via topic_hint — cancel/return/refund/replace/internet. v1.5 (spec v1.7 CS docs Phase 4): added a dedicated 'deposit' tile (Deposit refund) split out of refund — deposit needs contract-group (2024/12/11) judgment; scope = AI_Deposit Refund + AI_Cancellation (notice-period dependency) + REFUNDDEPOSIT CASHBACK + GENERAL. Now 11 tiles (Others still last). CS proposals to split Signal/APN/Internet and Plans were NOT adopted (kept 1 tile each + diagnostic ask / always_escalate); Lost and Replacement kept separate.
